tasks.subject: Task 1: JitterBuffer terminator tag (monotonic + clear)
tasks.description:

tasks.subject: Task 2: SpeakerStream hold-on-underrun + boundary reset
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Stop the cursor free-running through silence: hold on live underrun, reset in place at talkspurt boundaries, retire only after a long idle.

**Files:**
- Modify: app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/SpeakerStream.kt
- Test: app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/SpeakerStreamTest.kt

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Held cursor on live underrun; resumed packet at held timestamp accepted by offer (BUG REGRESSION TEST).
- Terminator or >= maxHoldTicks sustained hold resets in place (cursor=-1, tag cleared); not immediate retire.
- Second talkspurt re-anchors and honors prebuffer (stale-tag closed).
- Retire only after retireIdleTicks idle ticks.
- Short pause keeps stream and decoder.
- Measured holes concealed then decoded.

**Verify:** ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest --tests "me.danielstiner.dumble.mumble.voice.SpeakerStreamTest"

**Steps:** rewrite fillTick; add plcHold/plcAdvance/resetToIdle; ctor params maxHoldTicks=10, retireIdleTicks=500 + idleTicks; remove maxConsecutivePlc/idleOrRetire; update 2 retire tests; add 4 new tests. Full detail: plan Task 2.

tasks.subject: Task 4: Decode->mix pipeline tests (gaps/terminators/multi)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove the decode->mux path is correct: feed scripted timelines (contiguous, gap+resume, terminated, multi-speaker) through SpeakerStream + AudioMixer as playbackLoop does, and assert the mixed PCM.

**Files:**
- Create: app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/VoicePipelineMixTest.kt

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Single speaker contiguous frames mux to exactly the decoded pattern.
- A gap muxes to silence during the hold, then resumes (no loss) — bug coverage.
- A terminated frame plays, then resets to silence.
- Two simultaneous speakers mux to the exact integer sum.
- One speaker in a gap: mux equals the other speaker alone.

**Verify:** ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest --tests "me.danielstiner.dumble.mumble.voice.VoicePipelineMixTest"

**Steps:** create VoicePipelineMixTest.kt with a mixTick() helper mirroring playbackLoop and 5 tests; run + full suite; commit. Full detail: plan Task 4.

tasks.subject: Task 5: On-device verify lateDrops~0 vs VAD peer
tasks.description:
**Goal:** **USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task was requested by the user in the current conversation. It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every item in acceptanceCriteria has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

Confirm on a real device that received voice is continuous and lateDrops no longer climbs when a desktop (VAD) Mumble peer speaks over UDP.

**Files:**

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- udpAudioRx == voiceRx and decryptFail == 0 in the same stats.

**Verify:** ./gradlew installDebug; adb logcat -c && adb logcat | grep -E "MumbleManager|AudioVoiceEngine"; hold a >=60s two-way conversation over UDP with a desktop VAD peer.

tasks.subject: Task 6: Clear stale terminator tag (review fix)
